produced_by: genre-choice skill, run by a Claude Opus 5 agent with the repo as its working directory

image_prompt.text: a flat grassy terrain base of green grass covering the whole 200x200 stud map, with a slight rolling-hills surface texture

Flat circular and square stone tower-placement platforms framing both sides of the winding dirt path at strategic positions, visually distinct from the grass with a different colour and a glowing edge marker
A medieval stone fortress closing the far end of the path — stone walls, battlements, and a gate facing the path — an impressive landmark at the path's end
several medieval-style trees scattered around the map edges and between the curves of the path
rocks and boulders of various sizes placed as natural decoration around the map
small medieval decorations — barrels, crates, bushes, and broken stone ruins — near the castle and along the map edges

layout_placement.text: The medieval castle at the end of the path that players must defend, representing their primary health pool
The mouth of the dirt path at the dark stone archway portal in the far corner, where each enemy wave enters

notes: would have asked: 'Sounds like a tower defense map: one winding enemy lane from a spawn portal in one corner to the castle you defend in the opposite corner, flat stone build platforms along the lane, plus your trees, rocks and medieval decorations. Want that as-is?'

would have asked: the Tower Defense preset also carries choke-bottleneck (a pinch point where waves bunch up). Dropped it — the prompt specifies a single uniform PathWidth attribute and a path 'wide enough for enemies to walk along', with no narrowing. Preset otherwise taken whole, shape unchanged.
would have asked: 'Anything else you want in the space?' — nothing was added, so the map is exactly the eight elements listed.

P6 is the genre-wide route for lane-actor-track and is not overridden: the winding lane is generated procedurally as one continuous, valid, non-self-crossing route from the spawn portal to the castle gate, then dressed as dirt path over grass.
Scale: the prompt states roughly 200x200 studs, medium-sized. No per-pick count was stated — 'multiple' platforms, 'several' trees, 'various' rocks are not numbers.

terrain-relief was considered and rejected: the ground is explicitly 'flat with slight rolling hills texture', which is surface texture rather than landform, so the build stays off P0 + tiered. Likewise buildzone-plateau was rejected in favour of buildzone-grid because the tower platforms are flat and alongside the path, not raised inside path loops.

The spawn portal is a dark stone archway the prompt wants visible, but spawner-npc is a layout-only row in Strategy, so the archway geometry has no image-stream carrier — the dresser should build the archway at the wave origin marker.

Prompt asks for exposed Roblox attributes not expressible in this handoff: PathColor, GrassColor, TowerPlatformColor, CastleSize, PathWidth, DecorationCount. The path is to be the dominant visual feature, clearly contrasting with the grass.
No Universal Option was used: nothing in the prompt asks for inhabitants, enterable interiors, water, settlement density, terrain relief, or islands.
